answer: Pay rewards only from protocol emission earned by real graded work, never from deposits or raw headcount. Spinning up extra identities then yields nothing: each one must still perform, like a yarrow stalk that only counts if it actually grows. There is no lotus-pool of free money to split per account. The payout rests on shale, thin unless genuine labor thickens it, so a hundred empty sybils simply collect a hundred shares of zero.
